scope: Stage-0 integrity repair plus bounded deterministic falsification only; no GA and no portfolio intervention.

path_amendment.rule: canonical file must exist and be hashed before extraction; parent is not silently rewritten

episode_semantics.decision_start: first causal session baseline drawdown crosses -8% under episode builder
episode_semantics.peak_field: reporting field is mislabeled and is not used to select decision timestamp
episode_semantics.episode28: right-censored; report primary frozen label 0 and sensitivity label 1

provenance.current_constituent_breadth_dispersion: survivorship-contaminated; controls only, not primary scientific evidence
provenance.valid_fraction: excluded from scientific scoring; negative-control only

missingness: No episode deletion or outcome-conditioned imputation. Raw causal scores primary; shadow_z1 excluded from primary tests.

prespecified_scores.threshold_rule: rank diagnostic: minimum positive score; count negatives at-or-above

primary_gate.note: fixed Astra threshold additionally reported; rank gate used for Claude diagnostics

stability: same-regime sibling contrasts 2020-02-27 vs 2020-03-06 and 2022-03-07 vs 2022-04-20
